description: Fetches information about the Trello Workspace (organization) to which a specific board belongs, returning details for the Workspace only, not the board itself or its content.

fields.description: Specifies the fields to be returned for the organization. Use 'all' to retrieve all available fields, or provide a comma-separated list of specific fields. Valid fields include: 'billableMemberCount', 'desc', 'descData', 'displayName', 'idBoards', 'invitations', 'invited', 'logoHash', 'memberships', 'name', 'powerUps', 'prefs', 'premiumFeatures', 'products', 'url', or 'website'.
fields.title: Fields
